projects.title: Alathereonn: a Portfolio Website
projects.description: Personal portfolio of Zakaria Fattawari, as known as Alathereonn that is built with modern web technologies. Features smooth scroll, dynamic typing effects, and custom CSS animations.

projects.title: ECHOES: The Undying Follower
projects.description: ECHOES: The Undying Follower is a retro-inspired survival horror game set inside St. Mercy Asylum, a psychiatric hospital hidden in Eden’s Gloria, a town that was abandoned and erased from maps after its residents vanished without a trace.

projects.title: Final Thesis
projects.description:
'Don't get stressed out doing your final thesis, okay?' 
Final Thesis is a tense, first-person psychological horror game that transforms the grueling reality of academic pressure into a literal nightmare.

projects.title: Layanan Fakultas Rekayasa dan Teknologi Industri ITK (Layanan FRTI ITK)
projects.description: A web platform for FRTI ITK that centralizes faculty information, academic services, lecturer directories, accreditation data, news, agenda, and administrative service access. The website is designed to provide a clear, responsive, and user-friendly experience for students, lecturers, staff, and public visitors.

projects.title: PDF Compressor
projects.description: A Dockerized PDF compression app with a Rust backend and Vue.js frontend. It handles PDF uploads through a REST API, runs parallel compression jobs with worker processes, tracks processing progress, and serves compressed files for download. A final project for Functional Programming subject.

projects.title: Dashboard Kesehatan untuk Smart City - Prototype
projects.description: Prototype for final project in Smart City Support Information System subject.

projects.title: Churn Prediction for Telco Customer
projects.description: Website Customer Churn prediction for Telco Customer. A team project from Machine Learning subject.

projects.title: AI Personal Scheduler
projects.description: A web-based personal scheduler that utilizes AI to optimize and manage daily tasks and appointments. A team project from Web-Based Application Development subject.

projects.title: Connect 4 AI Game
projects.description: Implementation and Comparative Study of Alpha-Beta Pruning, Transposition Tables, and MTD(F) for Minimax Algorithm in a Two-Player Connect Four Game. A team project from ntroduction to Artificial Intelligence subject.

projects.title: ECHOES: The Undying Follower WIKI
projects.description: Echoes Wiki is a digital encyclopedia platform designed to systematically archive, organize, and manage information related to the indie game ECHOES: The Undying Follower.

projects.title: Distributed Sync System
projects.description: A distributed synchronization system based on the Raft Consensus Algorithm. It simulates real-world scenarios, effectively handling multiple nodes to communicate and synchronize data consistently.

projects.title: Pub-Sub Log Aggregator with Idempotent Consumer and Deduplication
projects.description: A Publish–Subscribe (Pub-Sub) log aggregation service that ingests events from publishers and distributes them to idempotent consumers, ensuring each event is processed only once through built-in deduplication.
